annotations.title: List officials by place, office and party

description: List current U.S. officeholders filtered by state, city or county, level (federal, state, county, city), office (e.g. us_house, state_senate, mayor, city_council, sheriff) and party, with paging. Returns each person's id (use with get_person), office, party, place, district, crowdsourced rating (average and count, or null), canonical link and placeUrl (the town or county page listing them, when live), plus the total number of matches. Party is recorded for most federal and state officials; most local offices are nonpartisan, so local party is usually null. Ratings are voluntary, not a poll. Only current officeholders are listed (officeStatus officeholder); get_person gives officeholder_elect and takesOfficeOn.
name: list_officials
title: List officials by place, office and party
